summary: By Artin–Rees (exists_graph_subrepresentation) c is, on the elements (u(g) − 1) + b^k·v, the value of a map whose graph Y is a subrepresentation with injective first projection. Hence c vanishes where all u_x(g) = 1 (on the inertia off S), and c(h) = c(g) whenever u(h) ≡ u(g) mod b^k, which is an open condition since the u_x are continuous: c is locally constant. Cocycle and L-relations are given.
